params.name: Cover frame and hook

params.name: One focal point
params.evidence: Twelve identical ledger copies have no focal point; s6 elements compete; s7p2 headline and picture disagree.

params.name: Script fidelity
params.evidence: Most panels show their visual_intent; s6 ledger reads as an envelope and s5p2 change is modest.

params.name: Layout choice
params.evidence: Layout tags do not match content and all 14 panels share one headline-card-caption template.

params.name: Readability
params.evidence: Pass 1 captions ran words together; fix1 readable but spacing uneven and only 6 panels re-proofed.

params.name: Platform fit
params.evidence: Headline at y 8% sits in the top interface zone; panels average about 5.2 s.

params.name: Rhythm
params.evidence: Equal halves and a copied beat grid; s2, s4, s6, s7 have no peak panel.

params.name: Cast used well
params.evidence: The faceless podium is rights-safe; the relay hands do not pass anything.

params.name: Numbers honest
params.evidence: Every on-screen figure matches a verified fact.

params.name: Ending and loop
params.evidence: s7p2 lands the idea but the headline LAST SEEN: ATHENS works against the picture.
